entries.name: Ailyssa's island errand
entries.text: Ailyssa asks the new party to check the shore and bring a Potion Bottle back to her. Follow the island signs, speak with Sally by the water, then secure a bottle through the island's supply route and return it to Ailyssa.

objectives.label: Speak with Sally by the shore
Bring a Potion Bottle back to Ailyssa
